Ellie Park: Hey everyone! Ellie here (she/her)  started today on SDKs. Big fan of waffles, sci-fi paperbacks, and improvised ukulele chords. Mostly remote but planning to come in Tuesdays. Excited to meet y'all :waffle: :books:
Mateo Ruiz: welcome Ellie!! :tada: Tuesdays are prime waffle day at the office, you picked well. Also small FYI we have a "bring-a-plant" shelf in the lounge if you want a leafy roommate :seedling:
Hana Suzuki: hi Ellie  welcome! are you team maple or team berry on waffles? quick poll: maple/berry/savory
Ellie Park: maple all the way. also mild nut allergy (no hazelnut) 
Ben Cho: welcome! tagging @reception-bot for badge + desk setup. Also we do a tiny ukulele jam on Fridays at 4pm if you ever want to swing by (very casual)
reception-bot: Badge request received for Ellie Park. Badge will be at reception for pickup today after 11:00. Temporary desk assigned: 5F hot desk A3. Note: allergy flag added to lunch notes.
Mateo Ruiz: added you to the waffle sign-up thread and the ukulele hangouts channel. Also heads-up: snack cabinet contains spicy sesame peas (optional) :yum:
Ellie Park: thanks everyone! Ill grab the badge after lunch. Looking forward to waffle day and the jam 
Hana Suzuki: welcome again  I'll drop by Tuesday and bring a tiny pothos for the shelf unless you already have one in mind :smile:
